parts.name: M1-seam-1-pin

parts.note: Flat XY print; two 1.2-mm locking leaves flex in the layer plane. Pin carries the load; barbs retain the removable key.

parts.name: splice-plate
parts.note: Splice plate: 6-mm tongue registering in the gap along the rear wall and neck top, floor-following foot 0.5 mm above the desk, outer wall, 8-degree lid rail, a flat shelf across the joint and the fence channel that receives the centre contact. Epoxied to both halves. Prints standing as assembled: vertical walls and one 27-mm bridge at the shelf.

parts.name: center-contact
parts.note: Centre contact, exchangeable: the 15-mm fence peg with its 5.4-mm foot in the splice-plate channel, the seat head (R2 seat, V5 C relief) merged onto it through a plate that bears on the shelf across the joint. Lift out to swap for another machine. Profile on bed.
